ch-1-1.explain:
你的原案例

Your Original Case

本章采用中国石油大学（华东）2025 级新生数据，阐述数据的特性。为了防止数据隐私泄露，数据采用 DeepSeek 大模型生成。数据文件 data/newstudent.csv，含 80 条记录。

This chapter uses the 2025 new-student data from China University of Petroleum (East China) to illustrate the characteristics of data. To prevent data privacy leaks, the data was generated by the DeepSeek large language model. The data file data/newstudent.csv contains 80 records.

嵌入理论：AI 合成数据的可信度边界

Embedded Theory: The Trustworthiness Boundary of AI-Synthesized Data

数据质量四维度（Wang & Strong 1996）：准确性 / 完整性 / 一致性 / 时效性。

Four Dimensions of Data Quality (Wang & Strong 1996): Accuracy / Completeness / Consistency / Timeliness.

DeepSeek 生成数据：

Data Generated by DeepSeek:

  • ✅ 完整性：字段齐全
  • ✅ Completeness: all fields present
  • ⚠️ 准确性：姓名/籍贯是虚构的，不能用作真实人口分析
  • ⚠️ Accuracy: names/hometowns are fictional and cannot be used for real demographic analysis
  • ⚠️ 采样偏差：模型倾向"看起来合理"的分布（如民族偏汉族、籍贯偏大城市）
  • ⚠️ Sampling bias: the model tends toward 'plausible-looking' distributions (e.g., over-representing the Han ethnicity, favoring large cities for hometowns)

课堂要点：教学场景使用合成数据没问题，但必须标注"合成数据"，避免学生误以为真实分布。

Classroom Takeaway: Using synthetic data in teaching is fine, but it must be labeled as 'synthetic data' to prevent students from mistaking it for a real distribution.

关键代码 ① 字段名映射

Key Code ① Field Name Mapping

中文列名映射成英文变量名 —— 避免 JS 中带中文 key 引发语法/编码隐患。

Map Chinese column names to English variable names — to avoid syntax/encoding issues caused by Chinese keys in JS.

⭐ // 关键点 ①：字段映射 —— 中文 → 英文
const COLUMN_MAP = {
  "序号": "id",
  "姓名": "name",
  "性别": "gender",
  "生日": "birthday",
  "年龄": "age",
  "班级": "class",
};

关键点解释：为什么不用中文 key？ (1) JS 引擎对中文标识符的容错性差（老浏览器报错）；(2) 后端、JSON、URL 编码都可能引入乱码； (3) IDE 自动补全、搜索、重构工具对中文支持不一致。 最佳实践：CSV 用人可读的中文名，JS 内部统一英文变量。

Key-Point Explanation: Why not use Chinese keys? (1) JS engines have poor tolerance for Chinese identifiers (older browsers throw errors); (2) backends, JSON, and URL encoding may introduce mojibake; (3) IDE autocomplete, search, and refactoring tools have inconsistent support for Chinese. Best Practice: Use human-readable Chinese names in CSV, and use unified English variables internally in JS.

关键代码 ② 类型转换函数

Key Code ② Type Conversion Functions

CSV 加载后所有字段都是字符串，需要把序号/年龄 → Number，生日 → Date 对象。

After CSV loading, all fields are strings; you need to convert the index/age to Number and the birthday to a Date object.

⭐ // 关键点 ②：类型转换函数 —— 用户原文「推荐方式」
function transformRow(d) {
  return {
    id:       +d["序号"],              // 一元 + 把字符串转 Number
    name:     d["姓名"].trim(),       // trim() 去掉首尾空白
    birthday: new Date(d["生日"]), // 字符串 → Date 对象
    age:      +d["年龄"],
    class:    d["班级"].trim(),
  };
}

关键点解释： +d["年龄"] 是一元加运算符，是 JS 里把字符串转数字的最快写法（比 Number() / parseInt() 都短）； new Date(str) 能解析 "2007-08-15" 这类 ISO 格式，但对 "2007/8/15" 兼容性差，要用 d3.timeParse("%Y-%m-%d") 兜底。 坑：没有 trim() 的话，"软件工程1班 " 里的空格会让后续过滤/聚合出错。

Key-Point Explanation: +d["年龄"] is the unary plus operator, the fastest way in JS to convert a string to a number (shorter than Number() / parseInt()); new Date(str) can parse ISO formats like "2007-08-15", but has poor compatibility with "2007/8/15", so fall back to d3.timeParse("%Y-%m-%d"). Pitfall: Without trim(), the trailing space in "软件工程1班 " will cause later filtering/aggregation to fail.

关键代码 ③ d3.csv 第二参直接传 row 回调

Key Code ③ Pass the row callback directly as the second argument of d3.csv

⭐ // 关键点 ③：一行完成加载 + 转换（用户原文「代码示例 1」）
const data = await d3.csv("data/newstudent.csv", transformRow);

// 验证类型确实转换了：
console.log(typeof data[0].age);        // "number"
console.log(data[0].birthday instanceof Date); // true

关键点解释：d3.csv 是异步函数，必须 await。 第二参的 row 回调会在每一行解析后立即调用——比先 await d3.csv(...) 再 .map(transformRow) 更省内存（边读边转）。 异步加载的意义：不阻塞页面渲染，用户能继续交互。

Key-Point Explanation: d3.csv is an asynchronous function and must be awaited. The row callback in the second argument is invoked immediately after each row is parsed — which saves memory compared to first await d3.csv(...) then .map(transformRow) (transform while reading). Significance of Asynchronous Loading: It does not block page rendering, so the user can keep interacting.

你的原案例

Your Original Case

DI 金 W 金字塔：数据是"原始原始数据"，信息是"组织好的数据"，知识是"模式/规律"，智慧是"判断/战略"。

DIKW Pyramid: Data is 'raw data', Information is 'organized data', Knowledge is 'patterns/regularities', and Wisdom is 'judgment/strategy'.

层原文回答的问题
数据原始、离散的观察结果—
信息经过处理、组织、赋予上下文的数据谁 / 什么 / 何时 / 何地
知识对信息的进一步提炼和理解如何
智慧运用知识做出明智判断和战略决策为什么 / 应该怎么做
TierTermQuestion Answered
DataRaw, discrete observations—
InformationData that has been processed, organized, and given contextWho / What / When / Where
KnowledgeFurther refinement and understanding of informationHow
WisdomApplying knowledge to make wise judgments and strategic decisionsWhy / What to do

嵌入理论：可视化在 DIKW 中的位置

Embedded Theory: The Position of Visualization in the DIKW Model

关键洞见：可视化主要把 Data 升到 Information，少数场景能升到 Knowledge，但难以跨越到 Wisdom。

Key Insight: Visualization mainly lifts Data to Information; in a few scenarios it can reach Knowledge, but it is difficult to cross over to Wisdom.

  • ✅ Data → Information：把表格"翻译"成可读图形（折线图、柱状图、热图）
  • ✅ Data → Information: 'Translate' the table into readable graphics (line chart, bar chart, heatmap)
  • ⚠️ Information → Knowledge：模式发现需要统计模型辅助（机器学习）
  • ⚠️ Information → Knowledge: Pattern discovery requires statistical models (machine learning)
  • ❌ Knowledge → Wisdom：决策与战略超出可视化能力
  • ❌ Knowledge → Wisdom: Decisions and strategy are beyond the capability of visualization

Rowley (2007) 批评：DIKW 是过度简化的层次模型，现实中 Data 与 Information 的界限模糊。但作为教学脚手架，仍然最有价值。

Rowley (2007) Critique: DIKW is an oversimplified hierarchical model; in reality the boundary between Data and Information is blurred. But as a teaching scaffold, it remains most valuable.
ch-1-2.code:
关键代码 ① SVG 金字塔路径

Key Code ① SVG Pyramid Path

金字塔由 4 个 trapezoid 拼接而成 —— D3 path 的 d 属性。

The pyramid is composed of 4 trapezoids joined together — the d attribute of the D3 path.

⭐ // 关键点 ①：trapezoid 路径 —— 从上到下 4 个点的连线
const topW = 60, botW = 120;
const yTop = 20, yBot = 100;
const path = `
  M ${cx - topW/2} ${yTop}
  L ${cx + topW/2} ${yTop}
  L ${cx + botW/2} ${yBot}
  L ${cx - botW/2} ${yBot}
  Z
`;

关键点解释：SVG path 的 M(moveto)、L(lineto)、Z(close) 是 3 个最常用指令。 模板字符串 `${...}` 可以直接嵌入 JS 变量，比字符串拼接更可读。 实践：复杂形状用 D3 的 d3.symbol()（内置 ★●▲ 等），自己 path 容易出错。

Key-Point Explanation: The SVG path commands M (moveto), L (lineto), and Z (close) are the three most commonly used. Template literals `${...}` can embed JS variables directly, making them more readable than string concatenation. Practice: For complex shapes, use D3's d3.symbol() (which has built-in ★●▲ etc.); hand-writing paths is error-prone.

关键代码 ② 交互高亮（hover/click）

Key Code ② Interactive Highlighting (hover/click)

⭐ // 关键点 ②：选择集绑定事件 —— D3 的事件模型
const g = svg.append("g")
  .style("cursor", "pointer")
  .on("mouseover", function() {       // 注意 function 而非箭头函数
    d3.select(this).select("path")
       .transition().duration(150)
       .attr("fill", d3.color(layer.color).brighter(0.5));
  })
  .on("click", () => showDetail(layer));

关键点解释：必须用 function() 而非箭头函数—— 因为 D3 回调里要用 this 访问当前元素，箭头函数会捕获外层 this 导致失效。这是 D3 最常见的坑。 transition().duration() 是 D3 内置动画 API，比 jQuery 还简洁。

Key-Point Explanation: You must use function() instead of arrow functions — because D3 callbacks use this to access the current element, and arrow functions capture the outer this, causing it to fail. This is the most common D3 pitfall. transition().duration() is D3's built-in animation API, even more concise than jQuery.

Your original text gives 3 types of attributes:

  • 类别型属性：符号或名称，无顺序关系（性别、姓名）
  • Categorical Attribute: a symbol or name with no ordering (gender, name)
  • 序数型属性：属性值有顺序（学位：本科/硕士/博士）

Embedded Theory: Stevens Measurement Scales (1946) — 4 Types

Stevens 把测量尺度分为 4 类，比你的原文更精细：

Stevens divides measurement scales into 4 types, finer than your original text:

Key Difference: The interval scale has no 'true zero point' (0°C is not 'no temperature'); the ratio scale has a true zero (0 yuan = no money).

嵌入理论：Mackinlay 视觉通道排序（1986）

Embedded Theory: Mackinlay Visual Channel Ranking (1986)

Mackinlay 提出视觉通道分 3 档：

Mackinlay proposes dividing visual channels into 3 tiers:

档次通道适合的属性
定量型位置、长度、角度比率 / 区间
顺序型亮度、密度、饱和度序数
定性型色相、形状名义
TierChannelSuitable Attribute

核心发现：位置是最强的定量通道；色相是最强的定性通道。错配 → 信息丢失。

Core Finding: Position is the strongest quantitative channel; hue is the strongest qualitative channel. Mismatch → information loss.
ch-1-3.code:
关键代码 ① 比例尺选型

Key Code ① Scale Selection

⭐ // 关键点 ①：scale 选型 —— 属性 ↔ 通道的映射
// 比率型数据 → scaleLinear（连续定量）
const x = d3.scaleLinear().domain([0, 100]).range([0, 800]);

// 名义/序数型数据 → scaleBand（离散分类）
const x = d3.scaleBand().domain(["软件1班", "软件2班"]).range([0, 800]);

关键点解释：D3 比例尺的 domain() 是数据域（输入），range() 是值域（输出像素）。 选错比例尺是初学者最常犯的错：类别数据用 scaleLinear 会算出没有意义的中间值（如 0.5 班）。 记忆口诀：连续定量用 Linear，离散分类用 Band，序数可用 Point。

Key-Point Explanation: A D3 scale's domain() is the data domain (input) and range() is the value range (output pixels). Choosing the wrong scale is the most common beginner mistake: using scaleLinear for categorical data produces meaningless intermediate values (e.g., class 0.5). Memory Aid: Use Linear for continuous quantitative, Band for discrete categorical, and Point for ordinal.

关键代码 ② colormap 选型

Key Code ② Colormap Selection

⭐ // 关键点 ②：颜色映射 —— 顺序型 vs 定性型 vs 发散型
// 顺序型（顺序有意义）→ interpolateViridis / interpolateBlues
const color = d3.scaleSequential(d3.interpolateViridis);

// 定性型（无顺序）→ schemeTableau10
const color = d3.scaleOrdinal().range(d3.schemeTableau10);

// 发散型（有中点）→ interpolateRdBu
const color = d3.scaleDiverging(d3.interpolateRdBu);

关键点解释：Viridis 是顺序 colormap 的标杆，色觉缺陷（CVD）友好且感知均匀。 常见错误：用彩虹色 interpolateRainbow 编码数值数据 —— 既不 CVD 友好，又有假边界（蓝色→绿色跳跃）。 课堂提问：什么时候用发散型？答：有"中间值"的数据（如正负、温度 vs 平均值）。

Key-Point Explanation: Viridis is the benchmark sequential colormap — color-vision-deficiency (CVD) friendly and perceptually uniform. Common Mistake: Using the rainbow colormap interpolateRainbow to encode numerical data — it is neither CVD-friendly nor free of false boundaries (blue→green jumps). Class Question: When to use a diverging colormap? Answer: Data that has a 'middle value' (e.g., positive/negative, temperature vs. average).

  2. map(iterable, mapper) — similar to Array.map
  3. reduce(iterable, reducer, init) —— 类似 Array.reduce
  4. reduce(iterable, reducer, init) — similar to Array.reduce
  5. cross(...iterables, reducer) —— 笛卡尔积
  6. cross(...iterables, reducer) — Cartesian product
  7. merge(iterables) —— 合并为扁平数组
  8. merge(iterables) — merge into a flat array
  9. pairs(iterable, reducer) —— 相邻元素对
  10. pairs(iterable, reducer) — adjacent element pairs
  11. transpose(matrix) —— 矩阵转置
  12. transpose(matrix) — matrix transpose
  13. zip(...arrays) —— 按位合并
  14. zip(...arrays) — combine by position
  15. filter(iterable, test) —— 类似 Array.filter
  16. filter(iterable, test) — similar to Array.filter

嵌入理论：函数式数据流

Embedded Theory: Functional Data Flow

这 8 个函数的共同特点：

Common characteristics of these 8 functions:

  • ✅ 不可变（immutable）：输入不变，返回新数组
  • ✅ Immutable: input unchanged, returns a new array
  • ✅ 纯函数：相同输入 → 相同输出，无副作用
  • ✅ Pure function: same input → same output, no side effects
  • ✅ 可链式：返回值是数组，可以接下一层变换
  • ✅ Chainable: returns an array, can be followed by the next transformation

为什么函数式？

Why Functional?

  • 可推理：每层变换独立可测
  • Can be reasoned about: each transformation layer is independent and testable
  • 可并行：map/reduce/filter 天然支持并行化
  • Parallelizable: map/reduce/filter are naturally parallelizable
  • 可缓存：纯函数的输出可以记忆化
  • Cacheable: outputs of pure functions can be memoized

数据立方体（OLAP）雏形：transpose 做宽/长格式转换，group + rollup 做切片/切块/钻取 —— 这正是 BI 系统的核心。

The Prototype of the Data Cube (OLAP): transpose performs wide/long format conversion, and group + rollup performs slicing/dicing/drilling — this is exactly the core of BI systems.
ch-1-4.code:
关键代码 ① map / reduce 的链式组合

Key Code ① Chained Composition of map / reduce

⭐ // 关键点 ①：函数式数据流 —— map 后接 filter 再 reduce
const avgAge =
  students
    .filter(s => s.gender === "男")    // ① 过滤男生
    .map(s => s.age)                    // ② 提取年龄
    .reduce((sum, a) => sum + a, 0) // ③ 合计
  / students.filter(s => s.gender === "男").length; // ④ 求平均

关键点解释：链式调用的每一步返回新数组，不会修改原数组。 与命令式对比：命令式需要 4 个临时变量 + 一个 for 循环，函数式一行搞定。 性能权衡：每次 map/filter 都会创建新数组，对超大数组有性能损耗（百万级以上才显著）。

Key-Point Explanation: Each step of the chained call returns a new array and does not modify the original array. Compared with Imperative: The imperative style needs 4 temporary variables + a for loop, while the functional style does it in one line. Performance Trade-off: Each map/filter creates a new array, which incurs a performance cost for very large arrays (only significant above the million level).

关键代码 ② cross（笛卡尔积）

Key Code ② cross (Cartesian Product)

⭐ // 关键点 ②：cross —— 笛卡尔积，用于两两组合
const genders = ["男", "女"];
const majors  = ["软件工程", "数据科学"];
const combos  = d3.cross(genders, majors);
// → [["男","软件工程"], ["男","数据科学"], ["女","软件工程"], ["女","数据科学"]]

关键点解释：笛卡尔积常用在"两两组合"分析（如性别 × 专业的人数统计）。 第二参 reducer 可选，用来"合并"两个元素。 扩展：3 个数组的笛卡尔积是 8 种，n 个数组的笛卡尔积是乘积大小。

Key-Point Explanation: The Cartesian product is commonly used in 'pairwise combination' analysis (e.g., counting students by gender × major). The second reducer argument is optional and is used to 'combine' the two elements. Extension: The Cartesian product of 3 arrays yields 8 combinations; for n arrays it is the product of their sizes.

关键代码 ③ group / rollup（聚合）

Key Code ③ group / rollup (Aggregation)

⭐ // 关键点 ③：group 与 rollup —— 层次聚合
// group 返回 Map（保留所有元素）
const byClass = d3.group(students, s => s.class);
// rollup 返回 Map（每个 key 只保留聚合值）
const countByClass = d3.rollup(
  students,
  v => v.length,
  s => s.class
);

关键点解释：group vs rollup 是"分组保留"vs"分组聚合"的区别。 rollup 第二参是 reducer 函数（这里取长度），后续章节 doc-02 会详细用 rollup 做树形数据。

Key-Point Explanation: group vs rollup is the difference between 'keep groups' and 'aggregate groups'. The second argument of rollup is a reducer function (here it takes the length); in later chapter doc-02, rollup will be used in detail for tree-structured data.

嵌入理论：Data-Join 三态模型（Mike Bostock）

Embedded Theory: The Data-Join Three-State Model (Mike Bostock)

D3 的核心是 Data-Join：把数据数组"绑定"到 DOM 元素上。

The core of D3 is Data-Join: 'binding' a data array to DOM elements.

当数据变化时：

When the data changes:

  • 新数据 > 旧数据：多出来的进入 enter（要 append）
  • New data > old data: the extras enter enter (need to append)
  • 新数据 = 旧数据：原有元素进入 update（要改属性）
  • New data = old data: the existing elements enter update (need attribute changes)
  • 新数据 < 旧数据：多余的元素进入 exit（要 remove）
  • New data < old data: the surplus elements enter exit (need to remove)

Data-Join vs 命令式 DOM

Data-Join vs Imperative DOM

关键代码 ① .join(enter, update, exit) 三态

Key Code ① .join(enter, update, exit) Three States

⭐ // 关键点 ①：D3 v5+ 的 join() API —— 优雅处理三态
const circles = svg.selectAll("circle")
  .data(currentData)
  .join(
    enter  => enter.append("circle").attr("fill", "green"),  // enter
    update => update.attr("fill", "cyan"),                              // update
    exit   => exit.remove()                                                   // exit
  );

关键点解释：join 的三个回调分别在 enter / update / exit 阶段被调用。 这种"声明式三态"比 v3 的 enter().append() + exit().remove() 写法更简洁，逻辑更不易出错。 类比：React 的 diff + patch —— 同样思想，但 React 帮你做了，D3 让你自己写变换函数。

Key-Point Explanation: The three callbacks of join are invoked in the enter / update / exit phases respectively. This 'declarative three-state' pattern is more concise than the v3 enter().append() + exit().remove() style, and less error-prone. Analogy: React's diff + patch — the same idea, but React does it for you, while D3 lets you write the transformation functions yourself.

关键代码 ② key 函数保身份

Key Code ② key Function Preserves Identity

⭐ // 关键点 ②：key 函数 —— 元素身份的稳定器
// ❌ 不带 key：数据顺序变化 → 所有元素都"update"，过渡动画错乱
svg.selectAll("circle").data(newData);

// ✅ 带 key：用唯一字段绑定身份，元素"知道自己是哪个"
svg.selectAll("circle").data(newData, d => d.id);

// 同样的逻辑用 React 描述：key={item.id}

关键点解释：key 函数是 D3 动画的灵魂。 没有 key 时，D3 按 index 绑定身份：数据重排会导致"所有元素都换位置"。 带 key 后，每个 circle 知道自己的 id 是什么，重排时只是 cx 变化，过渡动画自然。 类比：与 React 的 key={item.id} 完全相同的思想。

Key-Point Explanation: The key function is the soul of D3 animation. Without a key, D3 binds identity by index: reordering data causes 'all elements to move'. With a key, each circle knows its id, and on reorder only cx changes, so the transition animation is natural. Analogy: Exactly the same idea as React's key={item.id}.

关键代码 ③ d3.select vs d3.selectAll

Key Code ③ d3.select vs d3.selectAll

⭐ // 关键点 ③：选择器的核心区别
// select：返回 1 个元素（第一个匹配）；数据绑定只对这一个元素
const title = d3.select("#title");

// selectAll：返回多个元素；数据绑定按顺序一一对应
const bars = d3.selectAll(".bar").data(values);

关键点解释：select 用于"操作单个元素"，selectAll 用于"批量绑定数据"。 常见错误：用 selectAll(".bar") 给一个数组绑定数据时，元素数量与数据数量必须匹配，否则会"留空"或"溢出"。 最佳实践：先用 selectAll 创建占位元素（可能为空），再 .data().join(...)。

Key-Point Explanation: select is used to 'operate on a single element', and selectAll is used to 'bind data in bulk'. Common Mistake: When using selectAll(".bar") to bind data to an array, the number of elements must match the number of data items, otherwise it will 'leave gaps' or 'overflow'. Best Practice: First use selectAll to create placeholder elements (possibly empty), then .data().join(...).

ch-2-1.explain:
你的原案例

Your Original Case

3 个可视化流程模型：① 参考 Card 1999 模型绘制流程图（Box Flowcharts）→ ② Mackinlay 自动化准则 → ③ van Wijk 模型（含交互反馈）。

3 visualization pipeline models: ① Reference the Card 1999 model for box flowcharts → ② Mackinlay's automation principles → ③ van Wijk's model (with interaction feedback).

原始图片是你的概念图。本节课用 D3 重画这张概念图，每个节点点击后能展开细节。

The original image is your concept map. This lesson uses D3 to redraw this concept map — every node expands details when clicked.

嵌入理论：可视化流程的三个经典模型

Embedded Theory: Three Classic Models of the Visualization Pipeline

模型作者 / 年份核心思想
Card 数据流模型 Card, Mackinlay & Shneiderman, 1999 原始数据 → 数据表 → 视觉结构 → 视图（嵌套变换 D→T→V→C/L/S）
Mackinlay 自动化准则 Mackinlay 1986 对每种数据类型，自动选「量化准确性最高」的视觉通道（如：数值→位置、类别→色调）
van Wijk 反馈模型 van Wijk 2005 View ⇆ Filter ⇆ Param ⇆ Other Views —— 强调交互反馈循环
ModelAuthor / YearCore Idea
Card Data Flow Model Card, Mackinlay & Shneiderman, 1999 Raw data → data table → visual structure → view (nested transformations D→T→V→C/L/S)
Mackinlay's Automation Principles Mackinlay, 1986 For each data type, automatically pick the visual channel with the highest “quantitative accuracy” (e.g., quantitative → position, categorical → hue)
van Wijk Feedback Model van Wijk, 2005 View ↔ Filter ↔ Param ↔ Other Views — emphasizing the interaction feedback loop

核心教学要点：三个模型描述同一件事的不同侧面—— Card 给"管道"，Mackinlay 给"自动决策"，van Wijk 给"反馈环"。 三者是叠加关系，不是冲突关系。

Core teaching points: the three models describe different facets of the same thing — Card gives you the “pipeline,” Mackinlay gives you “automated decisions,” and van Wijk gives you the “feedback loop.” They layer on top of each other rather than conflict.

  • Card 模型：告诉你"transform 之后该 mapping，mapping 之后该 view"
  • Card model: tells you “after transform comes mapping, after mapping comes view”
  • Mackinlay：告诉你"mapping 这一步怎么自动决策"
  • Mackinlay: tells you “how to automate the mapping step”
  • van Wijk：告诉你"view 之后还要把用户操作 feed 回去"
  • van Wijk: tells you “after view, you still need to feed user actions back”

关键代码 ① SVG 流程图节点 + 箭头

Key Code — SVG Flowchart Nodes + Arrows

5 个 step 节点横向排列，相邻节点之间用 SVG marker 画的箭头连接。

5 step nodes arranged horizontally, connected by SVG-marker-drawn arrows between adjacent nodes.

⭐ // 1. 用  +  定义箭头
svg.append("defs").append("marker")
   .attr("id", "arrowhead")
   .attr("viewBox", "0 -5 10 10")
   .attr("refX", 8)            // 箭头位置校准
   .attr("markerWidth", 6)
   .attr("orient", "auto")       // 跟随线方向旋转
   .append("path").attr("d", "M0,-5L10,0L0,5").attr("fill", "#94a3b8");

⭐ // 2. 用 marker-end 引用箭头（重要）
svg.append("line")
   .attr("marker-end", "url(#arrowhead)")
   .attr("x1", x1).attr("y1", y).attr("x2", x2).attr("y2", y);

⭐ // 3. 节点 ↔ 数据 绑定：d3.data + click 事件
svg.selectAll(".node").data(nodes)
   .join("g")
   .on("click", (event, d) => {
     // ⭐ 关键：classed 是 D3 状态管理核心 API
     svg.selectAll(".node").classed("selected", n => n.id === d.id);
     document.getElementById("d-4-1-detail").innerHTML = d.detail;
   });

关键点解释： marker-end="url(#arrowhead)" 是 SVG 引用的方式 —— 把 里定义的形状"嵌入"到线段末端； classed("selected", predicate) 接收布尔函数，一次性切换所有节点的"selected"状态，避免自己写 forEach。

Key explanation: marker-end="url(#arrowhead)" is SVG's referencing mechanism — it “embeds” a shape defined inside at the line's end; classed("selected", predicate) takes a boolean function and toggles the “selected” state of every node in one call, so you avoid writing forEach yourself.

ch-2-2.explain:
📌 本节在流程中的位置：数据变换（Data Transformation）

📌 Where This Sits: Data Transformation

Card 1999 数据流模型把可视化拆成四段： 原始数据 → (变换) → 数据表 → (映射) → 视觉结构 → (渲染) → 视图。 本节讲的 2.2，就是第一段箭头 「原始数据 → 数据表」—— 这正是 数据变换（Data Transformation）。

The Card 1999 data-flow model splits visualization into four stages: raw data → (transform) → data table → (map) → visual structure → (render) → view. Section 2.2 is the first arrow, “raw data → data table” — i.e. Data Transformation.

你的原案例

Your Original Case

用新生数据按 "专业 / 班级" 做 rollup 分桶聚合。 你演示的核心是 d3.rollup 的链式调用 —— 一个函数完成多维度分组。

Use the freshman data to do rollup bucketed aggregation by “major / class”. The core of your demo is d3.rollup's chained calls — one function that performs multi-dimensional grouping.

理论补丁：数据变换的四大操作（Card 1999 D 层）

Theory Patch: Four Operations of Data Transformation (Card ’s D layer)

从「原始数据」到「数据表」，D 层做四类操作（注意：原文 4.2 节只讲了"分桶聚合"，这里把它放到完整的数据变换框架里）：

Going from “raw data” to a “data table,” the D layer performs four kinds of operations:

操作做什么D3 实现
清洗 / 过滤 (clean / filter)去缺失、去异常、筛选满足条件的行.filter()、d3.csv(row) 回调
聚合 / 汇总 (aggregate)按 key 分组，把同组归约为一个值d3.rollup()、d3.group()
连接 / 关联 (join)按键把两张表拼起来（如把学生表 join 班级表）d3.map + 手动索引
派生 / 衍生 (derive)由已有列算出新列（如从"班级"切出"专业"）row 回调里算一个新字段
OperationWhat it doesD3 implementation
Clean / filterRemove missing/outliers; keep rows matching a condition.filter(), d3.csv(row) callback
AggregateGroup by key, reduce each group to a single valued3.rollup(), d3.group()
JoinCombine two tables by key (e.g., student table joined to class table)d3.map + manual indexing
DeriveCompute a new column from existing ones (e.g., extract “major” from “class”)compute a new field in the row callback

本节演示的 rollup 聚合，属于"聚合"这一行。但读懂这张表，你才知道 数据变换是整个可视化流水线的"第一公里" —— 数据表没整理好，后面映射/渲染全都白搭。

The rollup aggregation demonstrated here belongs to the “aggregate” row. But reading this table, you realize data transformation is the “first kilometer” of the whole pipeline — if the data table isn't clean, all the mapping and rendering downstream is wasted.

嵌入理论：函数式聚合与 OLAP 切片

Embedded Theory: Functional Aggregation and OLAP Slicing

d3.rollup 是"按 key 分桶、再 reduce 一次"的函数式组合：

d3.rollup is a functional composition of “bucket by key, then reduce once”: 

const result = d3.rollup(
  data,                    // 输入数组
  v => v.length,          // reducer
  d => d.major,           // key1（外层）
  d => d.class           // key2（内层，可选）
);

它返回 Map（不是数组、不是对象），所以：

It returns a Map (not an array, not an object), so:

  • 遍历用 for ([k, v] of m) 或 m.entries()
  • Iterate using for ([k, v] of m) or m.entries()
  • 嵌套 rollup 出嵌套 Map
  • Nested rollup produces a nested Map
  • 与 d3.group 的差别：rollup 把组内数据归约成一个值，group 保留原数组
  • Difference from d3.group: rollup reduces the in-group data to a single value, while group preserves the original array

理论补丁：OLAP 切片/切块/钻取

Theory Patch: OLAP Slice / Dice / Drill

1993 年 Codd 提出 OLAP 12 条准则，其中 3 个核心操作用 rollup 就能模拟：

In 1993 Codd proposed 12 OLAP rules; three of their core operations can be simulated with rollup:

  • 切片 (Slice)：固定一维度（如只看 2025 级）→ 等价于 .filter() 后 rollup
  • Slice: fix one dimension (e.g., only look at the 2025 cohort) → equivalent to .filter() then rollup
  • 切块 (Dice)：按两个维度分组 → 等价于双 key rollup
  • Dice: group by two dimensions → equivalent to a double-key rollup
  • 钻取 (Drill)：层层下钻 → 等价于嵌套 rollup + 递归展开
  • Drill: drill down level by level → equivalent to nested rollup + recursive expansion

教学要点：可视化系统的"下钻交互"通常背后就是 rollup + hierarchy 的组合。本节课演示 d3.rollup 的多层级能力。

Classroom Takeaway: a visualization system's “drill-down interaction” is typically backed by a combination of rollup + hierarchy. This lesson demonstrates d3.rollup's multi-level capability.
ch-2-2.code:
关键代码 ① 双层 rollup

Key Code — Double-layer Rollup

两层 key：外层 = 专业，内层 = 班级，reducer = 计数。

Two key layers: outer = major, inner = class, reducer = count.

⭐ // 双层 rollup：返回嵌套 Map，外层 key=专业，内层 key=班级
const nested = d3.rollup(
  students,
  v => v.length,           // 每组聚合为单一值（这里是 count）
  d => d.major,            // 外层 key
  d => d.class             // 内层 key（rest 参数，可继续加）
);

// 遍历嵌套 Map：
for (const [major, inner] of nested) {
  for (const [cls, count] of inner) {
    console.log(major, cls, count);
  }
}

关键点解释： d3.rollup 的 key 参数是rest 参数（...keys），所以传 1 个 → 单层 Map，传 2 个 → 嵌套 Map，传 3 个 → 3 层嵌套。 这就是 OLAP 的"维度组合"。

Key explanation: The key parameter of d3.rollup is a rest parameter (...keys), so passing 1 → single-layer Map, 2 → nested Map, 3 → 3-layer nesting. This is OLAP's “dimension combination.”

关键代码 ② 用正则提取专业

Key Code — Extract the Major via Regex

CSV 里只有"班级"字段（"软件工程1班"），需要用正则切出"专业"和"班级序号"。

The CSV only has a “class” field (e.g., “Software Engineering Class 1”), so a regex is needed to split out the “major” and the “class number.”

⭐ // d3.csv 第二参 row 回调里逐行 transform
const data = await d3.csv("./data/newstudent.csv", d => {
  const cls = d["班级"].trim();
  const m = cls.match(/^(.+?)(\d+班)$/);  // 中间非贪婪 + 末尾"数字+班"
  return {
    id:    +d["序号"],
    name:  d["姓名"].trim(),
    class: cls,
    major: m ? m[1] : cls,  // "软件工程1班" → "软件工程"
  };
});

关键点解释： 正则 /^(.+?)(\d+班)$/ 的 .+? 是非贪婪匹配，会让中间尽可能短、末尾留给 \d+班。 没这个非贪婪：.+ 会把整串都匹配走，剩下空，m[1] 就是 undefined。 这类正则坑学生常踩，必须掌握。

Key explanation: In the regex /^(.+?)(\d+班)$/, the .+? is non-greedy matching — it keeps the middle as short as possible and leaves the tail for \d+班. Without non-greedy: .+ would consume the whole string, leaving nothing, and m[1] would be undefined. This is a regex pitfall students frequently step on; you must master it.

ch-2-3.explain:
📌 本节在流程中的位置：视觉映射（Visual Mapping）

📌 Where This Sits: Visual Mapping

接上一节 2.2 数据变换，我们有了"数据表"。本节的 2.3 是第二段箭头 「数据表 → 视觉结构」 —— 也就是 视觉映射（Visual Mapping）。 它回答一个核心问题：数据里每个属性，该用哪个视觉通道来表达？

Following the 2.2 data transformation, we now have a “data table.” Section 2.3 is the second arrow, “data table → visual structure” — i.e. Visual Mapping. It answers one core question: for each data attribute, which visual channel should express it?

你的原案例

Your Original Case

你的 4.2 节提到"树形结构可视化"。这节展开树布局算法原理 —— 拿到层级数据后，怎么把节点摆到屏幕上不打架？

Your Section 4.2 mentioned “tree-structure visualization.” This lesson expands on the tree layout algorithm — once you have hierarchical data, how do you place nodes on screen without overlap?

理论核心：什么是视觉通道？Mackinlay 的排名

Theory Core: What Is a Visual Channel? Mackinlay's Ranking

视觉通道（visual channel）是指"把数据编码到视觉元素上"的载体： 位置、长度、面积、角度、颜色、形状、纹理…… Mackinlay 1986 给出经典排名：对不同数据类型，各通道的量化精确度不一样。 这就是下面这张图。

A visual channel is the carrier that “encodes data onto a visual element”: position, length, area, angle, color, shape, texture… Mackinlay (1986) gave the classic ranking: for different data types, the quantitative accuracy of each channel differs. That is the figure below.

  • 位置（Position）：三种数据类型都是第一 —— 人眼对位置最敏感
  • Position: ranks #1 for all three types — the eye is most sensitive to position
  • 定量数据：长度 → 角度 → 斜率 → 面积（长条形图比面积图准）
  • Quantitative data: length → angle → slope → area (bar charts beat area charts)
  • 名义数据：位置 → 色调（hue）→ 纹理 → 连接 → 形状
  • Nominal data: position → hue → texture → connection → shape

理论核心：图元（marks）与视觉通道的构成

Theory Core: Marks and the Composition of Visual Channels

视觉结构由 图元（mark）打底：点（Point）、线（Line）、面（Area）。 然后通过 通道把这些图元"做记号"：位置、颜色、形状、倾斜、大小。 下面两张图拆开讲。

The visual structure is built on marks: Point, Line, Area. These marks are then “marked up” through channels: position, color, shape, tilt, size. The next two figures break this apart.

理论核心：两类通道 —— 幅度 vs 标识

Theory Core: Two Channel Classes — Magnitude vs Identity

按"能不能表达量的多少"，通道分两类： 幅度通道（Magnitude）表达有序/定量属性；标识通道（Identity）表达类别属性。 选错类别 = 误导读者。

By “whether it can express magnitude,” channels split into two classes: Magnitude channels express ordered / quantitative attributes; Identity channels express categorical attributes. Picking the wrong class misleads readers.

本节案例的落点：树布局（Reingold-Tilford）本质上就是一种视觉映射 —— 用 位置通道 把层级关系编码成"父在上、子在下的树"。下面讲它的算法。

Where this lesson lands: tree layout (Reingold-Tilford) is essentially a visual mapping — it uses the position channel to encode hierarchy as “parent above, children below.” The algorithm follows.

嵌入理论：Reingold-Tilford 算法（d3.tree 的核心）

Embedded Theory: The Reingold-Tilford Algorithm (the core of d3.tree)

Reingold & Tilford 1981 年提出的算法，至今仍是 d3.tree() 的实现核心。核心思路：

The algorithm proposed by Reingold & Tilford in 1981 is still the implementation core of d3.tree(). Core idea:

  1. 第一遍（自底向上）：对每个父节点，计算其左右子树"占用多少横向空间"
  2. First pass (bottom-up): for each parent node, compute how much horizontal space its left and right subtrees “occupy”
  3. 第二遍（自顶向下）：给每个节点分配绝对 x 坐标（保证兄弟节点紧贴父节点中线且不重叠）
  4. Second pass (top-down): assign every node an absolute x-coordinate (so siblings hug the parent's centerline without overlapping)
  5. 第三遍：处理"线程"（threads）—— 修复子节点跨父中线时的对齐
  6. Third pass: handle “threads” — fix the alignment when children cross the parent's centerline

复杂度的处理：

Complexity handling:

  • O(n) 时间 —— 比简单的"递归平分"要快
  • O(n) time — faster than a naive “recursive halving”
  • 节点的左右子树宽度的最小值 = 至少容纳所有子节点的水平空间
  • A node's minimum left/right subtree width = the horizontal space needed at minimum to hold all its children
  • 不同布局策略选型：d3.tree（左右）、d3.cluster（左右紧贴）、d3.treemap（面积）
  • Layout-strategy options: d3.tree (left-right), d3.cluster (left-right, packed), d3.treemap (area)

理论补丁：d3-hierarchy 模块全家桶

Theory Patch: The d3-hierarchy Module Family

  • hierarchy(data)：把任意嵌套 data 转成 hierarchy 结构（每个节点加 parent/children/depth）
  • hierarchy(data): convert any nested data into a hierarchy structure (each node gets parent / children / depth)
  • tree().size([h, w])：reingold-tilford 算法，左右布局
  • tree().size([h, w]): Reingold-Tilford algorithm, left-right layout
  • cluster().size([h, w])：所有叶子节点对齐到同一深度
  • cluster().size([h, w]): align all leaf nodes to the same depth
  • treemap().tile(...)：面积（slice-and-dice / squarified / resquarify 算法）
  • treemap().tile(...): area-based (slice-and-dice / squarified / resquarify algorithms)
  • pack().radius(d => ...)：圆环打包（circle packing）
  • pack().radius(d => ...): circle packing
  • partition().size([h, w])：icicle / sunburst 布局
  • partition().size([h, w]): icicle / sunburst layout
ch-2-3.code:
关键代码 ① hierarchy + tree 三步走

Key Code — hierarchy + tree in Three Steps

这是 d3-hierarchy 的标准模式：先建 hierarchy、再求 tree layout、最后画 links + nodes。

This is the standard d3-hierarchy pattern: first build the hierarchy, then compute the tree layout, and finally draw links + nodes.

⭐ // 1. hierarchy：从嵌套 JSON → 计算每个节点的 parent/children/depth
const root = d3.hierarchy(rootData);

⭐ // 2. tree layout：给每个节点算 x/y 坐标
const treeLayout = d3.tree().size([360, 720]);
const treeData = treeLayout(root);

⭐ // 3. 画 links：父-子连线（Reingold-Tilford 算法结果就在这里）
g.selectAll(".link").data(treeData.links()).join("path")
  .attr("d", d3.linkHorizontal().x(d => d.y).y(d => d.x));

⭐ // 4. 画 nodes：圆 + 文字
const ng = g.selectAll(".node").data(treeData.descendants()).join("g")
  .attr("transform", d => `translate(${d.y}, ${d.x})`);

ng.append("circle").attr("r", 5);
ng.append("text")
  .attr("text-anchor", d => d.children ? "end" : "start")
  .attr("x", d => d.children ? -8 : 8)
  .text(d => d.data.name);

关键点解释： treeData.x 是深度方向（默认垂直），treeData.y 是水平方向（同一深度的不同节点）。 所以 linkHorizontal 用 x=d.y, y=d.x —— 横线方向走 y，垂直方向走 x。 这种"x 轴走 y、y 轴走 x"的 swap 是横向树特有的，记住。

Key explanation: treeData.x is the depth direction (vertical by default), while treeData.y is the horizontal direction (different nodes at the same depth). So linkHorizontal uses x=d.y, y=d.x — the horizontal direction rides on y, and the vertical direction rides on x. This “x-axis rides on y, y-axis rides on x” swap is unique to horizontal trees — commit it to memory.

关键代码 ② separation 控制父子间距

Key Code — separation Controls Parent-Child Spacing

separation 接收函数，返回 [node, parent] 之间的"间隔倍数"。

separation accepts a function and returns the “spacing multiplier” between [node, parent].

const treeLayout = d3.tree()
  .size([360, 720])
  .separation((a, b) => (a.parent === b.parent ? 1 : 2));
                              //   ↑ 兄弟节点紧贴        ↑ 非兄弟至少隔 2 倍

关键点解释： separation 默认值 (a, b) => a.parent === b.parent ? 1 : 2。 改成 0.5 → 全部挤一起；改成 2.0 → 树变宽。 Demo 里有个 slider 让你实时调看效果。

Key explanation: The default value of separation is (a, b) => a.parent === b.parent ? 1 : 2. Change it to 0.5 → everything squishes together; change it to 2.0 → the tree widens. There is a slider in the demo so you can adjust it in real time and see the effect.

ch-2-4.explain:
📌 本节在流程中的位置：视图渲染 + 用户交互

📌 Where This Sits: View Rendering + User Interaction

接上节 2.3 视觉映射，我们有了"视觉结构"。本节 2.4 是最后两段箭头： 「视觉结构 → 视图」（渲染） 和 「视图 ↔ 用户」（交互反馈）。 Card 模型的 V 层，加上 van Wijk 的反馈环，都落在这里。

Following the 2.3 visual mapping, we now have a “visual structure.” Section 2.4 covers the last two arrows: “visual structure → view” (rendering) and “view ↔ user” (interaction feedback). Card's V layer and van Wijk's feedback loop both land here.

你的原案例

Your Original Case

原文档用了 classed 控制节点样式、用 stopPropagation 阻止冒泡。重点是把 D3 树布局输出变成可交互的 HTML 列表。

The original document used classed to control node styles and stopPropagation to block bubbling. The focus is on turning the D3 tree layout output into an interactive HTML list.

嵌入理论：DOM 事件三阶段 + 事件委托

Embedded Theory: The Three Phases of DOM Events + Event Delegation

浏览器的事件流分三阶段（DOM 规范）：

The browser's event flow has three phases (per the DOM spec):

  1. 捕获 (capturing)：window → document → ... → 目标元素（从外到内）
  2. Capturing: window → document → ... → target element (outside to inside)
  3. 目标 (target)：目标元素本身
  4. Target: the target element itself
  5. 冒泡 (bubbling)：目标元素 → ... → document → window（从内到外）
  6. Bubbling: target element → ... → document → window (inside to outside)

默认监听的是冒泡阶段。你可以在监听器里 e.stopPropagation() 截断冒泡，让上层的监听器不再触发。

By default, listeners are registered on the bubbling phase. Inside a listener you can call e.stopPropagation() to cut off bubbling so ancestor listeners no longer fire.

理论补丁：动画 —— 视图渲染的"时间维"（van Wijk 反馈的直观体现）

Theory Patch: Animation — the “time dimension” of view rendering

动画（transition）不是"花哨"，而是视图渲染在时间维上的展开。 D3 里用 .transition().duration(ms)， 让属性从旧值平滑过渡到新值。教学价值在 duration 这一个参数：

Animation (transition) isn't “fancy” — it's the time dimension of view rendering. In D3 you use .transition().duration(ms) to smoothly interpolate an attribute from its old value to a new one. The pedagogical value lies in the single duration parameter:

  • duration=0：瞬间跳变，师生"看不出变化过程"
  • duration=0: instant jump — you can't “see the change happen”
  • duration=500：0.5 秒过渡，能看到展开/收缩/位移的流畅过程
  • duration=500: a 0.5 s transition — you see the expand / collapse / move smoothly
  • duration>1500：太慢，学生开始走神
  • duration>1500: too slow — students start to drift

本节的交互 demo 特意加了 duration 滑块， 让你现场改变这个参数，直观看到"渲染如何随时间展开"。这是理解"视图渲染 + 交互反馈"最直接的一课。

This lesson's interactive demo adds a duration slider so you can change this parameter live and see “how rendering unfolds over time.” It's the most direct lesson on “view rendering + interaction feedback.”

理论补丁：事件委托 (Event Delegation)

Theory Patch: Event Delegation

问题：列表里有 1000 个 li，给每个 li 都绑 click 监听器 → 慢、内存大、新增元素要重新绑。

Problem: if a list has 1000 li elements and you bind a click listener to each → it's slow, memory-heavy, and newly added elements have to be re-bound.

解法：只给父元素（ul/div）绑 1 个 click 监听器，利用冒泡机制 —— 子元素的 click 最终会触发父元素的监听器。用 e.target.closest('.label') 找到"实际点击的是哪个子元素"。

Solution: bind only 1 click listener on the parent element (ul / div) and lean on bubbling — a click on any child eventually triggers the parent's listener. Use e.target.closest('.label') to figure out “which child element was actually clicked.”

优势：1 个监听器代替 N 个、未来新增元素自动支持。

Advantage: 1 listener replaces N, and any future newly added elements are automatically supported.

关键 API：D3 classed()

Key API: D3 classed()

selection.classed("selected", true);          // 1) 添加 class
selection.classed("selected", false);         // 2) 移除 class
selection.classed("selected", d => d.id === pickId); // 3) 函数式批量切换

关键代码 ① 事件委托（一对多监听）

Key Code — Event Delegation (one-to-many listening)

用递归 buildList 构建可折叠树；用 liSel 上的 click 做事件委托，不绑到每个 label。

Use recursive buildList to construct the collapsible tree; use the click on liSel for event delegation rather than binding to each label.

⭐ // 父 ul 上绑一次 click，所有子 li 共享
function buildList(liSel, d) {
  const label = liSel.append("span").attr("class", "label");

  label.on("click.toggle", (event) => {
    // ⭐ 关键 ①：阻止冒泡 —— toggle 按钮不该触发"选中"
    event.stopPropagation();
    d.data._collapsed = !d.data._collapsed;
    render();
  });

  liSel.on("click.select", (event) => {
    // ⭐ 关键 ②：如果 click 来自 toggle，已经被 stopPropagation 阻断，不会到这里
    document.querySelectorAll("li").forEach(li => li.classList.remove("selected"));
    liSel.classed("selected", true);
  });
}

关键点解释： 这是经典的「阻止 toggle 按钮冒泡到 li 的 select 监听器」模式。如果不 stopPropagation， 点 toggle 时会同时触发"切换折叠"和"选中节点"，用户看着会困惑。 这是 DOM 事件机制的核心教学点。

Key explanation: This is the classic pattern of “stopping the toggle button from bubbling up to the li's select listener.” Without stopPropagation, clicking the toggle would simultaneously trigger “toggle collapse” and “select the node,” which would confuse users. This is a core teaching point about the DOM event mechanism.

关键代码 ② 嵌套递归 buildList

Key Code — Nested Recursive buildList

d3 selection 的递归渲染：每个 li 内部再有 ul/li，再递归 buildList。

Recursive rendering with d3 selections: every li contains another ul/li, then buildList recurses into it.

function render() {
  $tree.innerHTML = "";
  const ul = d3.create("ul");
  ul.selectAll("li").data([root]).join("li")
    .each(function(d) { buildList(d3.select(this), d); });
  $tree.appendChild(ul.node());
}

关键代码 ③ D3 过渡动画（transition + duration）

Key Code — D3 Transition (transition + duration)

视图渲染的"时间维"：让节点展开/收缩时平滑过渡，不是瞬间跳变。duration 由滑块实时控制。

The “time dimension” of view rendering: smoothly interpolate node expand / collapse instead of an instant jump. duration is controlled by a live slider.

⭐ // 关键：transition + duration = 让属性随时间平滑变化
svg.selectAll(".node")
  .transition()                                  // 进入过渡状态
  .duration(DURATION)                          // 时长（ms），滑块控制
  .attr("transform", d => `translate(${d.y}, ${d.x})`)
  .attr("opacity", 1);

// 新节点进入时：先设 opacity=0，再过渡到 1 → 淡入效果
ng.attr("opacity", 0)
  .transition().duration(DURATION).attr("opacity", 1);

关键代码 ④ 动画时长滑块（直接在 HTML/CSS 里控制）

Key Code — Animation Duration Slider




// JS：改变 DURATION 后重放动画
document.getElementById("dur").addEventListener("input", e => {
  DURATION = +e.target.value;
  render();   // 用新时长重新做一次过渡
});

关键点解释： 为什么用 innerHTML = "" 清空再重画？ D3 没有"智能更新"树结构（层级变化）的 API —— 节点展开/折叠会改变父子结构，最简单的做法是全量重新渲染。 用 selection.each() 配合 d3.select(this) 把原生元素转回 selection，这是 D3 与原生 DOM 互操作的关键模式。

Key explanation: Why use innerHTML = "" to clear and redraw? D3 has no “smart-update” API for tree structures (where hierarchy changes) — expanding or collapsing a node changes the parent-child structure, and the simplest approach is a full re-render. Use selection.each() together with d3.select(this) to convert the raw element back into a selection — this is the key pattern for D3-native-DOM interop.

ch-3-1.explain:
为什么要学颜色模型？

Why learn color models?

设计 colormap 时，不能直接用 RGB 插值——因为 RGB 不是感知均匀的（255,0,0 与 0,255,0 "看上去"亮度差很多）。你需要感知均匀的颜色空间（Lab / HCL）来插值，才能得到平滑的渐变。

When designing a colormap, do not interpolate directly in RGB—because RGB is not perceptually uniform (255,0,0 and 0,255,0 "look" very different in lightness). You need a perceptually uniform color space (Lab / HCL) to interpolate and get smooth gradients.

4 大颜色空间

The 4 major color spaces

  • RGB：加色模型，设备相关。屏幕显示的默认。
  • RGB: additive model, device-dependent. The default for screen display.
  • HSL：艺术家友好（色相/饱和度/亮度独立），但仍不感知均匀。
  • HSL: artist-friendly (independent hue / saturation / lightness), but still not perceptually uniform.
  • CIE Lab：感知均匀，设计 colormap 的黄金标准。
  • CIE Lab: perceptually uniform, the gold standard for designing colormaps.
  • CMYK：减色（印刷），web 可视化用不到。
  • CMYK: subtractive (print). Not used in web visualizations.

CVD（色觉缺陷）

CVD (Color Vision Deficiency)

约 8% 男性、0.5% 女性是色盲。常见三种：

About 8% of men and 0.5% of women are color-blind. Three common types:

  • 红色盲（protanopia）：约 1% 男性
  • Protanopia (red-blind): ~1% of men
  • 绿色盲（deuteranopia）：约 6% 男性（最常见）
  • Deuteranopia (green-blind): ~6% of men (most common)
  • 蓝色盲（tritanopia）：极罕见
  • Tritanopia (blue-blind): extremely rare

⭐ 关键代码

⭐ Key code

⭐ 关键点 1：RGB → HSL 手写

⭐ Key point 1: Hand-written RGB ↔ HSL

function rgbToHsl(r, g, b) {
  r /= 255; g /= 255; b /= 255;
  const max = Math.max(r, g, b), min = Math.min(r, g, b);
  let h, s, l = (max + min) / 2;
  if (max === min) { h = s = 0; }
  else {
    const d = max - min;
    s = l > 0.5 ? d / (2 - max - min) : d / (max + min);
    switch (max) {
      case r: h = (g - b) / d + (g < b ? 6 : 0); break;
      case g: h = (b - r) / d + 2; break;
      case b: h = (r - g) / d + 4; break;
    }
    h /= 6;
  }
  return [h * 360, s * 100, l * 100];
}

⭐ 自己写 RGB↔HSL 是为了理解每一步的物理含义——"最大通道决定色相、相减决定饱和度"——比用 d3 库更能理解色相为什么在 0-360° 循环。

⭐ Writing RGB↔HSL yourself is to understand the physical meaning of each step—"the largest channel determines hue, the difference determines saturation"—which is more illuminating than using a d3 library for understanding why hue cycles between 0–360°.

⭐ 关键点 2：CVD 模拟矩阵

⭐ Key point 2: CVD simulation matrix

const CVD_MATRICES = {
  deuteranopia: [
    [0.625, 0.375, 0.000],
    [0.700, 0.300, 0.000],
    [0.000, 0.300, 0.700]
  ],
  protanopia:   [[0.567, 0.433, 0.000], [0.558, 0.442, 0.000], [0.000, 0.242, 0.758]],
  tritanopia:   [[0.950, 0.050, 0.000], [0.000, 0.433, 0.567], [0.000, 0.475, 0.525]]
};

function simulateCVD([r, g, b], type) {
  const m = CVD_MATRICES[type];
  return [
    r * m[0][0] + g * m[0][1] + b * m[0][2],
    r * m[1][0] + g * m[1][1] + b * m[1][2],
    r * m[2][0] + g * m[2][1] + b * m[2][2]
  ].map(v => Math.round(Math.max(0, Math.min(255, v))));
}

⭐ 关键点 3：d3 内置多空间

⭐ Key point 3: d3's built-in multi-space support

const c = d3.color('rgb(100, 50, 200)');
c.rgb();   // {r, g, b}
c.hsl();   // {h, s, l}
c.lab();   // {l, a, b}  ← 感知均匀
c.hcl();   // {h, c, l}  ← Lab 极坐标版

ch-3-2.explain:
三类 colormap 对应不同数据语义

Three colormap families match three data semantics

  • 顺序型（Sequential）：数据有自然顺序（人口、温度）。单调亮度 + 单调色相。例子：Viridis / Plasma / Cividis
  • Sequential: data with a natural order (population, temperature). Monotonic lightness + monotonic hue. Examples: Viridis / Plasma / Cividis
  • 发散型（Diverging）：数据有意义的"中点"（如 0、正负偏差、白人中位数）。两端异色，中间白/浅。例子：RdBu / BrBG / PiYG
  • Diverging: data with a meaningful "midpoint" (e.g., zero, signed deviation, white median). Different hues at the two ends, white/light in the middle. Examples: RdBu / BrBG / PiYG
  • 定性型（Qualitative）：数据无序（如产品类别）。色相区分、亮度接近。例子：Tableau10 / Set1 / Set3
  • Qualitative: unordered data (e.g., product categories). Distinct hues, similar lightness. Examples: Tableau10 / Set1 / Set3

典型错误

Common mistakes

用发散型 RdBu 画"50 州谋杀率"（有序数据）——中段接近白色，看上去"谋杀率 = 100 附近"的州是"中点"——但 100 没有任何语义，纯属误导。

Using the diverging palette RdBu for "murder rates in 50 states" (ordinal data)—the middle band looks near-white, so states with a murder rate "around 100" appear to be the "midpoint"—but 100 has no semantic meaning, so this is purely misleading.

CVD 友好检查清单

CVD-friendly checklist

  • Viridis / Cividis：✅ 优（Nature Methods 推荐）
  • Viridis / Cividis: ✅ excellent (recommended by Nature Methods)
  • RdBu / BrBG：△ 中等（红绿对色盲不友好）
  • RdBu / BrBG: △ moderate (red-green pairs are not CVD-friendly)
  • Tableau10（定性）：△ 与色相相关
  • Tableau10 (qualitative): △ hue-related issues
  • Jet（彩虹谱）：⚠ 禁用
  • Jet (rainbow): ⚠ do not use

⭐ 关键代码

⭐ Key code

⭐ 关键点 1：d3 三类 scale 速记

⭐ Key point 1: d3's three scale families at a glance

// 顺序型：[0, 1] → 颜色
d3.scaleSequential(d3.interpolateViridis);

// 发散型：[0, 1] → 颜色（带中点反转）
d3.interpolateRdBu;          // t=0 蓝，t=1 红，t=0.5 白
d3.interpolateBrBG;

// 定性型：离散类别 → 颜色
d3.scaleOrdinal(d3.schemeTableau10);

⭐ 选错类型 = "撒谎"。比如用 Viridis 表示正负偏差，用户会以为"中点 = 白色"——但 Viridis 的中点是深紫色。

⭐ Choosing the wrong type = "lying". For example, using Viridis for signed deviations makes users assume "the midpoint is white" — but Viridis's midpoint is dark purple.

⭐ 关键点 2：决策表

⭐ Key point 2: Decision table

function pickColormap(data) {
  if (data.hasMeaningfulMidpoint) return 'diverging';
  if (data.isOrdered)              return 'sequential';
  return 'categorical';
}

ch-3-3.explain:
为什么需要 Lab 色域图？

Why do we need a Lab gamut diagram?

RGB 空间是立方体，但你不知道"哪些颜色真的存在、哪些会失真"。CIE Lab 是感知均匀空间，距离 ≈ 人眼感知差，是设计 colormap 和检查色域的标准。

RGB space is a cube, but you cannot tell "which colors actually exist and which would be distorted". CIE Lab is a perceptually uniform space, distance ≈ perceived difference, and is the standard for designing colormaps and checking gamut.

三个色域（嵌套关系）

Three gamuts (nested relationship)

  • sRGB：屏幕通用标准（Web/PPT/一般科研图）
  • sRGB: universal screen standard (Web / PPT / general scientific figures)
  • Adobe RGB：摄影/印刷，绿域更广
  • Adobe RGB: photography / print, wider green gamut
  • Rec.2020：4K 电视/HDR，色域最大
  • Rec.2020: 4K TV / HDR, the largest gamut

超出 sRGB 的颜色（如高饱和度的纯绿）在普通屏幕上显示不出来，会被 clamp。

Colors outside sRGB (e.g., highly saturated pure green) cannot be displayed on ordinary screens and get clamped.

实战用法

Practical usage

  • 从 d3.lab(L, a, b).rgb() 转换时，超出 sRGB 的颜色会自动 clamp
  • When converting from d3.lab(L, a, b).rgb(), colors outside sRGB are clamped automatically
  • 设计 colormap 时用 d3.interpolateLab（在 Lab 空间插值），比 d3.interpolateRgb 平滑得多
  • When designing colormaps, use d3.interpolateLab (interpolates in Lab space), which is far smoother than d3.interpolateRgb
  • 高饱和度色仅在打印/4K 屏幕上"存在"，Web 上看不一定准确
  • Highly saturated colors only "exist" on print / 4K screens, and may not look accurate on the Web

⭐ Key code

⭐ 关键点 1：Lab 颜色对象

⭐ Key point 1: Lab color object

// 直接构造 Lab 颜色
const c = d3.lab(50, 30, -20);    // L*=50, a*=30, b*=-20
console.log(c.rgb());              // → RGB {r, g, b}（clamp 到 sRGB）
console.log(c.formatHex());       // → "#xxxxxx"

// 从 RGB 反向构造
const c2 = d3.color('#ff0080');
console.log(c2.lab());             // → {l, a, b}

⭐ d3.lab() 返回的是 Lab 颜色对象，但显示时还是转回 RGB。Lab 是"思考空间"，RGB 是"显示空间"。

⭐ d3.lab() returns a Lab color object, but when displaying you still convert back to RGB. Lab is the "thinking space", RGB is the "display space".

⭐ 关键点 2：在 Lab 空间插值

⭐ Key point 2: Interpolate in Lab space

// 在 Lab 空间插值（感知均匀）
const interp = d3.interpolateLab('#000000', '#ffffff');
interp(0.5);   // → 中间灰（Lab 空间线性插值，结果感知均匀）

// vs 在 RGB 空间插值（不均匀）
const interpRgb = d3.interpolateRgb('#000000', '#ffffff');
interpRgb(0.5);  // → 中间灰（RGB 空间插值，但在 Lab 看来"不是中间"）

ch-3-4.explain:
5 大色系规则

The 5 major color scheme rules

  • 单色 Monochromatic：同一色相不同亮度/饱和。安全、低风险。
  • Monochromatic: the same hue with varying lightness / saturation. Safe and low risk.
  • 类比 Analogous：色轮相邻 ±30°。和谐但缺少对比度。
  • Analogous: adjacent on the color wheel, within ±30°. Harmonious but lacking contrast.
  • 互补 Complementary：色轮正对面 180°。对比度强但易刺眼。
  • Complementary: directly opposite on the color wheel at 180°. Strong contrast but can be jarring.
  • 三等分 Triadic：色轮 120° 等分。3 种类别时最常用。
  • Triadic: evenly spaced at 120° on the color wheel. The most common choice for 3 categories.
  • 分裂互补 Split：互补色相邻 150°。温和版互补。
  • Split-Complementary: adjacent to the complement at 150°. A softer version of complementary.

选择原则

Selection principles

  • 严肃科研：单色（Nature 黑白经济型配色）
  • Serious scientific work: monochromatic (Nature-style black-and-white economical palette)
  • 层级 / 分组：类比
  • Hierarchy / grouping: analogous
  • 突出重点：互补（实验组 vs 对照组）
  • Highlight a focal point: complementary (treatment vs control)
  • 3 种类别：三等分
  • 3 categories: triadic
  • 一般情况：分裂互补（不刺眼又有对比）
  • General cases: split-complementary (not jarring, but still has contrast)

⭐ Key code

⭐ 关键点 1：HSL 色相差

⭐ Key point 1: HSL hue difference

const HUE_OFFSETS = {
  monochromatic: 0,     // 同色相
  analogous:     30,    // ±30°
  complementary: 180,   // 180° 对面
  triadic:       120,   // 120° 三等分

// 生成 5 色调色板
function palette(baseH, offset) {

}

  • Wong 2011: recommended in Nature Methods 8:441, 8-color, CVD-friendly and grayscale-print-friendly

  • Paul Tol: SRON Tech Note, bright (on white background) / muted (on dark background) / high-contrast

  • Okabe-Ito 2002: 8 colors, CVD-friendly, the default in early Nature/Science

商业 / 通用

Commercial / general purpose

4 个典型错误

4 typical mistakes

  • ⚠ 彩虹谱 Jet：非感知均匀 + CVD 不友好 + 打印不友好。Nature 已禁用。
  • ⚠ Rainbow palette Jet: not perceptually uniform + not CVD-friendly + not print-friendly. Nature has banned it.
  • ⚠ 红绿对比：红绿色盲眼中几乎变成同色（最严重的可访问性问题）
  • ⚠ Red-green contrast: to a red-green colorblind viewer, they almost become the same color (the most serious accessibility issue)
  • ⚠ 颜色过多 12 色：超过 7 种时眼睛无法区分
  • ⚠ Too many colors (12): the eye cannot distinguish beyond 7

让学生亲手投票，能加深对"为什么是错的"的理解——光看理论不如下场选错一次来得深。

你的配色哲学（落地到 3 条规则）

Your color philosophy (distilled into 3 rules)

  1. 颜色数量 ≤ 7：超过 7 种眼睛就分不清
  2. Color count ≤ 7: beyond 7 the eye cannot tell them apart
  3. 鲜艳颜色（高 H 区分度）：用 H 拉开类间距离（≥30°）
  4. Vivid colors (high H differentiation): use H to separate categories (≥ 30°)
  5. 低饱和度（S 30-50%）：每个色都别太"冲"，耐看
  6. Low saturation (S 30–50%): each color should not be too aggressive—easy on the eyes

经验公式

Empirical formulas

  • 主色 S = 70-80%（鲜明但不刺眼）
  • Primary color S = 70–80% (vivid but not harsh)
  • 配套色 S = 30-50%（低饱和，耐看）
  • Supporting color S = 30–50% (low saturation, easy on the eyes)
  • 强调色用互补或类比，不要全饱和
  • For accent colors, use complementary or analogous, avoid full saturation
  • 高亮用 L=85-90%（如背景、注释）
  • Highlights use L = 85–90% (e.g., for backgrounds, notes)

7 色生成规则

The 7-color generation rule

主色 + 2 类比（±30°）+ 1 类比低饱和 + 1 互补 + 1 互补低饱和 + 1 高亮 = 7 色，符合"≤ 7"原则。

Primary + 2 analogous (±30°) + 1 analogous low-saturation + 1 complementary + 1 complementary low-saturation + 1 highlight = 7 colors, conforming to the "≤ 7" principle.

⭐ 关键点 1：7 色生成规则

⭐ Key point 1: 7-color generation rule

function genPalette(H, S, L) {
  return [
    hslHex((H - 30 + 360) % 360, S * 0.6, L * 1.1),  // 类比 1 低饱和
    hslHex((H - 30 + 360) % 360, S, L),              // 类比 1
    hslHex(H, S, L),                                 // 主色
    hslHex((H + 30) % 360, S, L),                    // 类比 2
    hslHex((H + 30) % 360, S * 0.6, L * 1.1),        // 类比 2 低饱和
    hslHex((H + 180) % 360, S * 0.8, L * 0.95),      // 互补
    hslHex(H, S * 0.2, L * 1.4)                      // 高亮（极低饱和）
  ];
}

⭐ (H + offset + 360) % 360 是 HSL 色相循环的安全写法——避免负数或 > 360。

⭐ (H + offset + 360) % 360 is the safe way to cycle HSL hues—avoiding negatives or values > 360.

CVD testing workflow

  1. 把图导出 PNG

  4. Simulate with Coblis or Color Oracle
  5. 看是否仍能区分（亮度对比 / 形状 / 标签）

实测结论

Test results

  • Wong / Okabe-Ito / Paul Tol: ✅ distinguishable under all 3 types of CVD
  • 红绿对比：⚠ 在绿盲眼中几乎同色（最严重）

⭐ 关键代码

⭐ Key code

⭐ 关键点 1：把 SVG 中所有 fill 做 CVD 模拟

⭐ Key point 1: Apply CVD simulation to every fill in an SVG

function cvdTransformSvg(svgString, type) {
  const doc = new DOMParser().parseFromString(svgString, 'image/svg+xml');
  doc.querySelectorAll('[fill]').forEach(el => {
    const c = d3.color(el.getAttribute('fill'));
    if (!c) return;
    const rgb = [Math.round(c.rgb().r), Math.round(c.rgb().g), Math.round(c.rgb().b)];
    const sim = simulateCVD(rgb, type);
    el.setAttribute('fill', `rgb(${sim.join(',')})`);
  });
  return new XMLSerializer().serializeToString(doc);
}

⭐ 用 DOMParser 解析 SVG 字符串，遍历所有 fill 属性应用 CVD 矩阵。比手写 SVG 字符串拼接安全。

⭐ Use DOMParser to parse SVG strings, then walk all fill attributes and apply the CVD matrix. Safer than hand-concatenating SVG strings.

ch-4-1.explain:
🎨 本节使用了 colormap（Viridis）画热图。colormap 理论详见 第 3 章 3.2 colormap 三类选择。

你的原案例

Your Original Case

原 5.1 节用了 1985 美国 50 州犯罪数据（CSV），含 8 个犯罪指标列。

Section 5.1 used 1985 U.S. crime data (CSV) for the 50 states, with 8 crime-indicator columns.

嵌入陈为教材理论

Embedded Theory

  • 长格式（long）：每行一个观测，列 = 字段（如 {state, metric, value}）。优点：方便过滤、分组、绑定到 d3 join。
  • Long format (long): one observation per row, columns = fields (e.g., {state, metric, value}). Pros: easy to filter, group, and bind to a d3 join.
  • 宽格式（wide）：每行一个实体，列 = 指标（如 {state, murder, robbery, ...}）。优点：人眼读得懂、直观。
  • Wide format (wide): one entity per row, columns = metrics (e.g., {state, murder, robbery, ...}). Pros: human-readable and intuitive.
  • 转换：flatMap + 循环键名 = 几行代码搞定。
  • Conversion: flatMap + iterating over key names = a few lines of code.
  • d3.autoType：自动推断列类型（数字、日期、布尔），省得手动 +d.field。
  • d3.autoType: auto-infers column types (number, date, boolean), saving you from manual +d.field.

你的原案例

Your Original Case

原 5.1.2 节用散点展示 Crime 数据（murder vs robbery），坐标轴是 1985 数据。

Section 5.1.2 used a scatter plot to display Crime data (murder vs. robbery), with the 1985 data on the coordinate axes.

嵌入陈为教材理论

Embedded Theory

  • 三层空间：
    1. 数据空间：原始数值（如人口 27058000、谋杀率 8）
    2. 坐标系空间：归一化到 0..innerWidth（标准化坐标）
    3. 屏幕空间：加上 margin 偏移（最终像素位置）
  • Three-layer space:
    1. Data Space: raw values (e.g., population 27058000, murder rate 8)
    2. Coordinate Space: normalized to 0..innerWidth (standardized coordinates)
    3. Screen Space: add the margin offset (final pixel positions)
  • 为什么分层：坐标系空间内的元素（线、点）可以共享，切换屏幕尺寸时无需重算。d3.axisBottom 自动帮你做坐标系→屏幕。
  • Why layer them: elements inside the coordinate system space (lines, points) can be shared — no recalculation when the screen size changes. d3.axisBottom handles the coordinate-system → screen step automatically.
  • scale 选型：
    • scaleLinear：均匀分布，最常用
    • scaleLog：跨数量级（人口从 53 万到 2700 万）
    • scaleSqrt：面积感知（圆面积映射到值）
    • scaleBand：类别轴（柱状图）
  • Scale selection:
    • scaleLinear: uniform distribution, most common
    • scaleLog: spans orders of magnitude (population from 530k to 27M)
    • scaleSqrt: area-aware (maps circle area to value)
    • scaleBand: categorical axis (bar charts)

⭐ 关键代码

★ Key Code

⭐ 关键点 1：数据空间 vs 屏幕空间，两层 scale

★ Key Point 1: data space vs. screen space — two layers of scales

// 数据空间：值 → 坐标系
const xData = d3.scaleLinear()
  .domain([0, d3.max(data, d => d.x)])
  .range([0, innerW]);

// 屏幕空间：坐标系 → 屏幕（加 margin）
const xScreen = d3.scaleLinear()
  .domain([0, innerW])
  .range([M.l, M.l + innerW]);

// 渲染：数据 → 坐标系 → 屏幕
.attr('cx', d => xScreen(xData(d.x)))

⭐ 错位示范：直接把 domain/max 和 range/[M.l, M.l+innerW] 写在一个 scale 里 → 改 margin 要改两处。三层分立就清爽。

★ Misalignment example: writing domain=max and range=[M.l, M.l+innerW] in one scale → changing the margin means editing two places. The three-layer separation keeps things clean.

⭐ 关键点 2：log scale 跨数量级

★ Key Point 2: log scale spans orders of magnitude

// 50 州人口从 53 万到 2700 万（差 50 倍）
// linear 缩放下，小州挤成一团，CA/NY/TX 占满屏幕
const xLog = d3.scaleLog()
  .domain([1, d3.max(data, d => d.x)])
  .range([0, innerW]);

⭐ log 轴对"指数增长"数据特别合适。人的视觉是"乘法"而不是"加法"，所以 log 让"等比数列"在屏幕上"等距"。

★ A log axis is especially well-suited for “exponential growth” data. Human vision is “multiplicative” rather than “additive”, so log turns a “geometric sequence” into “equally-spaced” points on screen.

ch-4-3.explain:
你的原案例

Your Original Case

原 5.1.3 节用折线 + 散点展示趋势。原始代码用了 curveCatmullRom，没讲为什么。

Section 5.1.3 used a line + scatter plot to show trends. The original code used curveCatmullRom without explaining why.

嵌入陈为教材理论

Embedded Theory

  • 插值 vs 拟合：
    • 插值（interpolation）：曲线经过所有数据点（如 Catmull-Rom、Natural）
    • 拟合（fitting）：曲线不经过数据点，只反映趋势（如线性回归 LOESS）
  • Interpolation vs. Fitting:
    • Interpolation: the curve passes through every data point (e.g., Catmull-Rom, Natural)
    • Fitting: the curve does not necessarily pass through data points, only reflects the trend (e.g., linear regression, LOESS)
  • d3.line().curve() 提供 10+ 种 curve，最常用：
  • d3.line().curve() offers 10+ curves; the most commonly used are:
  • step 系：用于离散阶跃（数字信号、状态切换）
  • step family: for discrete steps (digital signals, state transitions)
  • catmullRom / natural：过所有点的张力样条，"看起来平滑"
  • catmullRom / natural: tension splines that pass through all points — “looks smooth”
  • monotoneX：保持原数据序列单调（不会出现伪震荡）
  • monotoneX: preserves the monotonicity of the original data sequence (no spurious oscillations)
  • 选择原则：数据有顺序性 → monotoneX / linear；数据本身抖动大 → catmullRom / basis 平滑；离散状态 → step
  • Selection principles: ordered data → monotoneX / linear; jittery data → catmullRom / basis to smooth; discrete states → step
ch-4-3.code:
⭐ 关键代码

★ Key Code

⭐ 关键点 1：d3.line + curve 一行切换

★ Key Point 1: switch curves with d3.line + curve in one line

const line = d3.line()
  .x(d => xScale(d.x))
  .y(d => yScale(d.y))
  .curve(d3.curveCatmullRom);     // <- 这一行换 curve 类型

svg.append('path').datum(data).attr('d', line);

⭐ datum(data) 把数组当整体传给 path（不是每个元素绑一个）。d3.line 内部循环生成 M/L/C 命令。

★ datum(data) passes the array as a whole to the path (not one element at a time). Inside, d3.line loops to generate M/L/C commands.

⭐ 关键点 2：拟合 vs 插值的取舍

★ Key Point 2: the trade-off between fitting and interpolation

// 拟合：d3.regressionLinear / d3.regressionLoess
import { regressionLinear } from 'd3-regression';
const lin = regressionLinear()
  .x(d => d.population)
  .y(d => d.murder)
  .domain([0, d3.max(data, d => d.population)]);
const points = lin(data);  // 起点-终点
svg.append('path').attr('d', d3.line()(points));

⭐ 经验法则：散点超过 30 个 → 用拟合；散点 < 10 个 → 用插值（保持信息完整）。Crime 数据 50 个州 → 拟合更稳。

★ Rule of thumb: more than 30 points → use fitting; fewer than 10 points → use interpolation (preserve full information). Crime data has 50 states → fitting is more robust.

ch-4-4.explain:
你的原案例

Your Original Case

原 5.1.4 节提到"平均倾斜度最优为 45°"，但没解释原因。

Section 5.1.4 mentions that “the optimal average slope is 45°” without explaining why.

嵌入陈为教材理论

Embedded Theory

  • Cleveland 1984 实验：让被试估计直线的斜率，发现：
    • 斜率 = 0° 或 90° 时，估计误差最大
    • 斜率 = 45° 时，估计最准
    • 呈 U 型曲线
  • Cleveland 1984 experiment: subjects were asked to estimate line slopes:
    • Slope = 0° or 90°: estimation error is largest
    • Slope = 45°: estimation is most accurate
    • The error curve is U-shaped
  • Stevens 幂律：感知斜率 ≈ (真实斜率)^1.0 ~ 1.3。即人眼把"陡度"夸张了 30%。
  • Stevens’ power law: perceived slope ≈ (actual slope)1.0–1.3. In other words, the eye exaggerates “steepness” by about 30%.
  • 设计原则：
    • 关键数据斜率落在 30°~60° 区间最稳
    • 对比增长曲线时，用 log 轴让陡度落在 45° 左右
    • 避免在 5° 以下或 85° 以上做趋势对比（误差太大）
  • Design principles:
    • Key data slopes are most stable in the 30°–60° range
    • When comparing growth curves, use a log axis so steepness lands near 45°
    • Avoid trend comparisons below 5° or above 85° (errors grow too large)
ch-4-4.code:
⭐ 关键代码

★ Key Code

⭐ 关键点 1：极坐标转笛卡尔坐标

★ Key Point 1: convert polar to Cartesian coordinates

// 角度 → 屏幕坐标
function lineAtAngle(angleDeg, length = 240, origin = {x: 100, y: 240}) {
  const r = (angleDeg * Math.PI) / 180;
  return {
    x1: origin.x,
    y1: origin.y,
    x2: origin.x + length * Math.cos(r),
    y2: origin.y - length * Math.sin(r)   // SVG y 向下为正，所以取负
  };
}

⭐ SVG 的 y 轴向下（与数学相反），所以 sin 角度项要取负。这是初学者最常踩的坑。

★ SVG’s y axis points downward (opposite to math convention), so the sine term must be negated. This is the most common pitfall for beginners.

嵌入陈为教材理论

Embedded Theory

  • Marching Squares 原理：把标量场离散化为网格，每个 cell 4 个角的"是否大于阈值"决定 case 编号 0~15（2⁴=16 种）。每种 case 对应 0/1/2 条线段，把"超过阈值"和"未超过阈值"的两片区域分开。
  • How Marching Squares works: discretize the scalar field into a grid. For each cell, the “above threshold / not” state of its 4 corners yields a case index from 0 to 15 (24 = 16 cases). Each case corresponds to 0, 1, or 2 line segments that separate the “above-threshold” region from the “not” region.
  • 16 种 case：编码 bit0=BL、bit1=BR、bit2=TR、bit3=TL。
  • 16 cases: encoded as bit0=BL, bit1=BR, bit2=TR, bit3=TL.
  • 扩展到 3D：Marching Cubes（Lorensen & Cline 1987），2⁸=256 种 case，常用于医学 MRI / CT 等值面提取。
  • Extension to 3D: Marching Cubes (Lorensen & Cline, 1987), with 28 = 256 cases, widely used for extracting isosurfaces from medical MRI / CT scans.
  • 应用场景：
    • 地形等高线（地图）
    • 医学影像（MRI/CT 等值面）
    • 密度等高图（核密度估计）
    • 天气预报（等温线、等压线）
  • Application scenarios:
    • Terrain contour lines (maps)
    • Medical imaging (MRI / CT isosurfaces)
    • Density contours (kernel density estimation)
    • Weather forecasting (isotherms, isobars)

Your Original Case

原 6.1 节列出 5 个时间属性，没有可视化。这章把这 5 个属性变成可交互卡片。

Original section 6.1 listed the 5 time properties without any visualization. This chapter turns those 5 properties into interactive cards.

嵌入陈为教材理论

Embedding Chen Wei's Textbook Theory

  • 有序性：时间是有序的，两个事件有先后次序，与因果关系紧密相连。
  • Order: Time is ordered—any two events have a before/after, tightly linked to causality.
  • 连续性：时间连续，两个时间点之间总存在另一个时间点。
  • Continuity: Time is continuous—between any two moments there is always another moment.
  • 周期性：自然过程常有循环规律（季节、昼夜），可采用循环时间域。
  • Periodicity: Natural processes often follow cyclic patterns (seasons, day/night)—a cyclic time domain can be used.
  • 独立于空间：时间与空间紧相关，但科学过程大多独立处理。
  • Independence from space: Time is tightly coupled with space, but scientific processes usually treat them independently.
  • 结构性：时间尺度分年/月/日/时/分/秒，分割既有自然反映（昼夜）也有人为定义（60 秒）。
  • Structure: Time scales split into year / month / day / hour / minute / second—some divisions reflect nature (day/night), others are human convention (60 seconds).

为什么 5 个属性都重要？

Why do all 5 properties matter?

设计时序图前先想清楚这 5 个属性，能避免常见错误：

Thinking through these 5 properties before designing a time series chart avoids common pitfalls:

  • 有序性缺失 → 散点图错位成噪声
  • Missing order → scatter plot misaligned into noise
  • 连续性混淆 → 离散数据用错连线
  • Confused continuity → discrete data wrongly connected
  • 周期性忽略 → 季节趋势被"抹平"
  • Ignored periodicity → seasonal trends “flattened out”
  • 结构性不匹配 → 工作日/周末、闰年都出错
  • Mismatched structure → weekdays/weekends, leap years all go wrong

Embedding Chen Wei's Textbook Theory

嵌入陈为教材理论

Embedding Chen Wei's Textbook Theory

  • 日历热图 (Calendar Heatmap)：van Wijk 2008 提出，x = 周（年内的第几周），y = 星期几，颜色 = 数值。
  • Calendar Heatmap: proposed by van Wijk 2008, x = week (week-of-year), y = day of week, color = value.
  • 适用场景：长时序（年）+ 周期性（星期 / 月）+ 异常检测（节假日、工作日 vs 周末）。
  • Use cases: long time series (years) + periodicity (weekday / month) + anomaly detection (holidays, weekday vs weekend).
  • 设计要点：
    • 每周从周日（或周一）开始——影响"周末"在视觉上的位置
    • 月份之间用红线分隔——比 7×53 网格更易读
    • colormap 用顺序型（如 Viridis）——见 第 3 章 3.2 colormap
  • Design Considerations:
    • Each week starts on Sunday (or Monday)—this affects where the “weekend” sits visually
    • Separate months with red lines—more readable than a 7×53 grid
    • Use a sequential colormap (e.g., Viridis)—see Chapter 3 §3.2 Colormap

isMonthDivider 的巧妙之处

The cleverness of isMonthDivider

判断 7 天前与今天是否同月——是则同月分割线，否则需要画月线。这是日历可视化的核心算法。

Check whether 7 days ago and today are in the same month—if so, draw a same-month separator; otherwise draw a month-divider. This is the core algorithm of calendar visualization.

function weekColSunday(date) {
  // 周日为每列起点 (getDay()=0)
  return Math.floor((d3.timeDay.count(
    d3.timeYear.floor(date), date)) / 7);

  .attr('height', cellSize)

⭐ 关键点 3：isMonthDivider 月份分隔

⭐ Key Point 3: isMonthDivider month separation

// ⭐ 巧妙算法：判断 7 天前是否同月
function isMonthDivider(date) {
  const sevenDaysAgo = d3.timeDay.offset(date, -7);
  return date.getFullYear() !== sevenDaysAgo.getFullYear()
      || date.getMonth()    !== sevenDaysAgo.getMonth();
}
// 同月：不画分割线；跨月：画一条上边框

function isFirstDayOfMonth(date) {
  return date.getDay() !== 0         // 排除周日（被周列开头替代）
      && date.getMonth() > 0         // 排除一月（画上边框没意义）
      && date.getDate() === 1;
}

⭐ 不用循环"找每个月的第一天"，改用"7 天前是否同月"——简洁又正确，O(n) 一遍扫描即可。这是日历热图作者 van Wijk 的精妙算法。

⭐ Instead of looping to “find each month’s first day,” use “are 7 days ago and today in the same month?”—simple and correct, just an O(n) single-pass scan. This is the elegant algorithm from calendar heatmap author van Wijk.

Your Original Case

原 6.2.3 节用阿基米德螺旋（等速螺旋）布局日期，每个回路代表 1 年 / 1 月 / 1 周。每个日期对应螺旋上的一个扇环。

Original section 6.2.3 used an Archimedean spiral (uniform-velocity spiral) to lay out dates, with each loop representing 1 year / 1 month / 1 week. Each date corresponds to a sector ring on the spiral.

嵌入陈为教材理论

Embedding Chen Wei's Textbook Theory

  • 螺旋 vs 折线：折线在线性时间域表现"趋势"，但难以表现"周期"；螺旋沿圆周重复，能突出周期性。
  • Spiral vs line: a line captures “trend” in a linear time domain but struggles with “cycle”; a spiral repeats around the circle, highlighting periodicity.
  • 阿基米德螺旋 (Archimedean Spiral)：r = a + bθ，等速展开（每转一圈半径增加常量 b）。
  • Archimedean Spiral: r = a + bθ, with uniform unwinding (radius increases by a constant b per revolution).
  • 动态 Δθ 算法：原文档的精妙点——Δθ = boxSize / √(b² + r²)，让每个扇环的弧长近似相等，保持视觉一致性。
  • Dynamic Δθ algorithm: the original document’s elegant move—Δθ = boxSize / √(b² + r²), which keeps each sector ring’s arc length roughly equal, preserving visual consistency.
  • 实战取舍：螺旋适合"年/季节/周"的循环，不适合"无周期"或"周期太长"。
  • Practical trade-offs: spirals suit “year / season / week” cycles, but are unsuitable when there is “no cycle” or “the cycle is too long”.

关键路径生成

Key Path Generation

每个日期对应螺旋上的一个扇环——4 个关键点：起点外/终点外/终点内/起点内，闭合回起点。

Each date maps to a sector ring on the spiral—4 key points: outer start / outer end / inner end / inner start, closing back to the start.
ch-5-4.code:
⭐ 关键代码

⭐ Key Code

⭐ 关键点 1：极坐标 → 笛卡尔坐标

⭐ Key Point 1: polar → Cartesian coordinates

// ⭐ 阿基米德螺旋公式：r = a + bθ
const boxSize = 32;                  // 每环宽度
const coilGap = boxSize * 1.2;       // 螺旋间距
const b = coilGap / (2 * Math.PI);   // 半径增长系数
const startRadius = 100;
let theta = (startRadius - 0) / b;   // 起始角度

function pos(t) {                    // t: 角度（弧度）
  const r = 0 + b * t;
  return {
    x: r * Math.cos(t),              // 极坐标转笛卡尔
    y: r * Math.sin(t),
    r
  };
}

⭐ 极坐标 = (r, θ)，笛卡尔 = (x, y)，θ 每增 2π，r 增 b——这就形成"每转一圈外扩一格"的螺旋。如果 b=0，就是普通圆周。

⭐ Polar = (r, θ), Cartesian = (x, y); θ grows by 2π, r grows by b—this produces a “one ring out per loop” spiral. If b=0, it becomes an ordinary circle.

⭐ 关键点 2：动态角度增量

⭐ Key Point 2: dynamic angle increment

// ⭐ 弧长近似相等：Δθ = boxSize / √(b² + r²)
function angleDelta(currentRadius) {
  return boxSize / Math.sqrt(b * b + currentRadius * currentRadius);
}

// 沿螺旋前进 N 天
let t = startTheta;
for (let day = 0; day < 365; day++) {
  const p = pos(t);
  // ...画第 day 天的扇环
  t += angleDelta(p.r);   // 动态加角度
}

⭐ 这条公式是原文档的核心洞察：当半径增大时，相同角度对应的弧长会变长，所以要让 Δθ 随半径增大而减小——这样"每个扇环的弧长"近似相等，视觉上整齐一致。

⭐ This formula is the original document’s core insight: as the radius grows, the same angle spans a longer arc, so Δθ must shrink as r grows—keeping each sector ring’s arc length roughly equal and visually uniform.

⭐ 关键点 3：扇环路径生成

⭐ Key Point 3: sector-ring path generation

// ⭐ 4 关键点：起点外 → 终点外 → 终点内 → 起点内
function segmentPath(t0, t1) {
  const coords = (t, sign) => {
    const r = pos(t).r + sign * coilGap / 2;  // sign=+1 外圈 / -1 内圈
    return [r * Math.cos(t), r * Math.sin(t)];
  };
  const [x0o, y0o] = coords(t0, +1);
  const [x1o, y1o] = coords(t1, +1);
  const [x1i, y1i] = coords(t1, -1);
  const [x0i, y0i] = coords(t0, -1);
  return `M ${x0o} ${y0o} L ${x1o} ${y1o} L ${x1i} ${y1i} L ${x0i} ${y0i} Z`;
}
// d 属性 = 'M ... L ... L ... L ... Z'，4 个 L 描述一个 4 边形

⭐ SVG path 极简：M 移动、L 画线、Z 闭合。手算 4 顶点比用 d3.arc() 灵活（d3.arc 是从圆弧角度算的，对螺旋无法直接用）。

⭐ SVG path in essence: M move, L line, Z close. Computing the 4 vertices by hand is more flexible than d3.arc() (which is built for circular arcs and cannot directly handle a spiral).

嵌入陈为教材理论

Embedding Chen Wei's Textbook Theory

  • Storyline 起源：2008 年斯坦福大学 Ogawa & Ma 提出，原本用于电影/学术合作者关系网。
  • Storyline origin: introduced by Ogawa & Ma at Stanford in 2008, originally for movie / academic collaborator networks.
  • 核心：把每个角色/组织/进程抽象为"生命线"，线靠近 = 角色相遇 / 冲突，线分开 = 角色分离。
  • Core idea: abstract each character / organization / process as a “life line,” where lines close = meeting / conflict, lines apart = separation.
  • 3 大元素：
    1. 时间尺度映射：电影时长 → SVG 宽度，x 轴严格按比例对齐
    2. Catmull-Rom 样条：curveCatmullRom.alpha(0.5) 张力系数 0.5，"自然流动"但不"过度弯曲"
    3. 事件层：半透明红圈 + 文字，标注关键转折点
  • Three Key Elements:
    1. Time-scale Mapping: movie duration → SVG width, with the x-axis strictly proportional
    2. Catmull-Rom Spline: curveCatmullRom.alpha(0.5) tension coefficient 0.5, “naturally flowing” but not “over-curved”
    3. Event Layer: semi-transparent red circles + text, marking key turning points
  • 应用场景：电影分析、案件多人时间线、体育比赛互动、项目任务交接。
  • Use cases: film analysis, multi-party case timelines, sports interactions, project task handovers.

为什么 Catmull-Rom 不用 monotoneX？

Why Catmull-Rom instead of monotoneX?

monotoneX 保证"不过度弯曲"但会让线"过于直"，失去叙事的"河流感"。Catmull-Rom 张力系数 0.5 是经验值——既能流动又不震荡。

monotoneX guarantees “no over-curving” but makes lines “too straight,” losing the narrative “river feel”. Catmull-Rom’s 0.5 tension is an empirical value—flows well without oscillating.

⭐ 关键代码

⭐ Key Code

⭐ 关键点 1：每个角色 = 一条 path

⭐ Key Point 1: each character = one path

// ⭐ 时间尺度：0-127 分钟 → 屏幕宽度
const xScale = d3.scaleLinear()
  .domain([0, 127])
  .range([50, width - 50]);

// 每个角色是一组 [time, y] 关键点（手工调 y 实现聚散）
const characters = [
  { name: 'T-REX', color: '#d32f2f', points: [
    {time: 75, y: 280}, {time: 78, y: 130},   // 攻击现场
    {time: 88, y: 200}, {time:120, y: 290}
  ]},
  { name: 'Grant', color: '#1976d2', points: [
    {time:  0, y: 100}, {time: 78, y: 130},   // 与 T-REX 聚拢
    {time:120, y:  50}
  ]}
];

// 路径生成器
const line = d3.line()
  .curve(d3.curveCatmullRom.alpha(0.5))   // 张力 0.5
  .x(d => xScale(d.time))
  .y(d => d.y);

characters.forEach(c => {
  svg.append('path')
    .datum(c.points)
    .attr('d', line)
    .attr('stroke', c.color)
    .attr('stroke-width', 3)
    .attr('fill', 'none');
});

⭐ 用 y 值表达"关系"是关键：T-REX 和 Grant 在 t=78 都画到 y=130，视觉上两条线聚拢= "T-REX 攻击 Grant"。这不是算法生成，是手工叙事设计——但 d3 提供工具让你能这样手工做。

⭐ Using y to encode “relationships” is the key: T-REX and Grant both at y=130 at t=78, so the two lines visually converge = “T-REX attacks Grant.” This isn’t algorithmically generated—it’s manual narrative design, but d3 gives you the tools to do it by hand.

⭐ 关键点 2：事件层（叙事锚点）

⭐ Key Point 2: event layer (narrative anchors)

// ⭐ 事件层：半透明红圈 + 文字标签
const events = [
  { time: 78, x: xScale(78), y: 130, name: 'T-REX 攻击',
    desc: 'T-REX 冲出围栏攻击 Alan & Kids 的车' },
  { time: 48, x: xScale(48), y: 320, name: 'Nedry 事件',
    desc: 'Dilophosaurus 攻击 Nedry' }
];

const eventLayer = svg.append('g').attr('class', 'event-layer');

eventLayer.selectAll('g.event')
  .data(events).enter().append('g')
  .attr('class', 'event')
  .style('cursor', 'pointer')
  .on('mouseenter', (e, d) => showTip(`${d.name}\n${d.desc}`))
  .each(function (d) {
    // 半透明背景圈
    d3.select(this).append('circle')
      .attr('cx', d.x).attr('cy', d.y).attr('r', 20)
      .attr('fill', 'rgba(255,0,0,0.15)');
    // 文字
    d3.select(this).append('text')
      .attr('x', d.x).attr('y', d.y - 9)
      .attr('text-anchor', 'middle')
      .attr('font-size', 10).attr('font-weight', 600)
      .attr('fill', '#cc0000')
      .text(d.name);
  });

⭐ 事件层与线层解耦：线层表达"关系流动"，事件层表达"叙事锚点"。这种双层结构是 Storyline 的标准设计——可分别动画、可独立筛选。

⭐ Decouple event layer from line layer: the line layer expresses “relationship flow,” the event layer expresses “narrative anchors.” This two-layer structure is the standard Storyline design—each can be animated or filtered independently.

⭐ 关键点 3：alpha(0.5) 张力系数

⭐ Key Point 3: alpha(0.5) tension coefficient

// d3.curveCatmullRom.alpha(t) - t ∈ [0, 1]
// t=0: 接近 linear（接近直线）
// t=0.5: 标准 Catmull-Rom（推荐）
// t=1.0: 接近 cardinal（高度曲线化）
d3.line().curve(d3.curveCatmullRom.alpha(0.5));

⭐ 选 0.5 是经验值：比 0 更"软"（看起来有故事感），比 1.0 更"稳"（不会过山车）。做时间叙事就用 0.5；做科学曲线拟合就用 0.2-0.3（更接近数据）。

⭐ 0.5 is an empirical value: softer than 0 (looks narrative), steadier than 1.0 (no roller-coaster). Use 0.5 for time-based narratives; use 0.2–0.3 for scientific curve fitting (closer to data).
